'''Nate Hyde Mommy Mommy I want a LightSaber''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Nate Hyde]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13693">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13693 Mommy Mommy I want a LightSaber], DeckTech (nate "deadbeat" hyde, 15 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13693/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13693/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018051216/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13693/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Mommy Mommy I want a LightSaber'''
* '''Author:''' nate "deadbeat" hyde
* '''Published:''' February 15, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' fun deck you have a GREAT chance of winning if you play it right

=== Strategy ===

ummm ok this deck will allow you to have a lot of power all around but all you really need to do is make shur you have a steady flow of all sorts of cards.  Have at least one effect inturrept character ship in hand at all times thats how i always play my games and i have won many times
